steps: Parked StarterPack tools (Spear, Dagger) into ServerStorage
Pulled 3 gladius reference photos (broad parallel-edge blade, long triangular point, small dark guard, ribbed grip, spherical pommel)
generate_mesh Cube gladius at 3.2 studs; capture_angles x3 confirmed silhouette matched references (parallel edges, triangular tip, dark guard, ribbed grip, round pommel)
make_tool -> Tool 'Gladius' with mesh as Handle; moved to StarterPack

recipe.text: Roman gladius short sword — distinct from prior spear/dagger/generic swords. Reference-first: Wikimedia gladius photos set the target features (broad straight double-edged blade with parallel edges, long triangular point, small hemispherical guard, ribbed pale grip, large round pommel). Cube generate_mesh with a slender-specific prompt produced a clean single-mesh match on the first pass (verified via capture_angles, no re-gen needed); save_mesh made it durable before toolifying. make_tool wrapped it (single part = Handle at hilt), then bind_behavior (fast: 0.12 windup / 0.15 active / 0.35 cooldown) and bind_hitbox (20 dmg, 7 reach, 0.35s server cooldown).
